title: Best of Shanghai with Disneyland and the Great Wall
alt: The Bund waterfront with the Pudong skyline behind it
transport: Private airport transfers and guided city touring

stops.name: Shanghai
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable base in Putuo close to the metro

activities.name: Half day guided tour of Shanghai
activities.description: A guided morning through the Bund waterfront, the old town lanes and the rockeries and ponds of the Yu garden.

activities.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
activities.description: Tickets up the city's best known tower, with the glass floor over Pudong and a long view back to the colonial Bund.

activities.name: Huangpu river cruise
activities.description: An evening sailing between the lit towers of Pudong and the stone facades of the Bund, the classic Shanghai skyline shot.

activities.name: Shanghai Disneyland
activities.description: A full day at Shanghai Disneyland with tickets included, home to the Enchanted Storybook Castle and the Tron ride.

activities.name: Southern Great Wall day trip
activities.description: A day out of the city to the Southern Great Wall, walking its watchtowers and ridge path away from the tour crowds.

program.name: Shanghai
program.description: Four nights in one city: the Bund, the Yu garden, the Pearl Tower and a river cruise, a full day at Disneyland and a day on the Southern Great Wall.

day_titles.2: City tour, tower and river cruise

1: Arrival at Pudong or Hongqiao and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: an evening walk on the Bund
Optional: the Shanghai Museum on People's Square
2: Breakfast, then a guided half day of the city
The Bund, the old town lanes and the Yu garden
Up the Oriental Pearl Tower in the afternoon
A cruise on the Huangpu as the towers light up
3: Breakfast, then a day at Shanghai Disneyland
Tickets included for the full day
The Enchanted Storybook Castle and the Tron ride
Back at the hotel in the evening
4: Early breakfast and transfer out of the city
A full day at the Southern Great Wall
Watchtowers, ramparts and the long ridge path
Evening transfer back to your Shanghai hotel
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: A park day and a wall day in the same four nights. Parents get the history, children get the rides, and nobody changes hotel.
expert.tip: Carry a hat and proper shoes for the wall day. The ridge path is steep in places and there is very little shade on top.

summary: Five days in Shanghai with daily breakfast: a guided half day of the Bund and the Yu garden, the Oriental Pearl Tower, a Huangpu cruise, a full day at Disneyland and a Southern Great Wall day trip.
included: Included: 4 nights in Shanghai with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; half day guided city tour; Oriental Pearl Tower tickets; Huangpu river cruise tickets; Shanghai Disneyland tickets; Southern Great Wall day trip.
not_included: Not included: international flights; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
